status: CANDIDATE (pre-pilot). The ONLY authoritative Part I protocol. Method configurations are NOT yet frozen: until the four hparams audits are back-filled and bound by md5 (next version), baselines may only be called 'pilot configurations', not 'audited formal baselines'. Any post-pilot change that can alter predictions or ranking -> new version + rerun of affected pilots.

data.splits: human: folds_partI.json (test, val); nonhuman: folds.json (test, val). Every runner reads frozen test/val IDs first, then applies its own training filter to the remaining training IDs

task: Given CDS sequence only (no Ribo-seq counts of test transcripts as input), predict relative per-codon RPF distribution on transcripts sequence-isolated from training

truth.definition: y_i = c_i / mean_full(c) over the whole CDS (zeros included), c = frozen avg_count (A-site)
truth.note: scoring takes subsets of y; the denominator never changes with the scoring domain

rules: adapter positions are never counted as model predictions
interior primary uses model positions only; a transcript whose interior domain contains adapter/undefined positions is unscorable for that method
full-length: deployed row (pre-registered endpoint policy, adapter fraction reported) and native-coverage row; no legitimate full-length output -> NA
undefined positions are never silently zero-filled

scorability.truth: domain has >= 3 positions and truth non-constant (interior requires L-40 >= 3, so L=41,42 excluded)
scorability.method: prediction finite and non-constant on the domain (model positions only for interior)

status_codes.MODEL_FAILED: seed x fold: all predictions non-finite or constant, or run failed within allowed attempts -> method's 3-seed main score on that dataset = FAILED
status_codes.NO_SCORABLE_TRUTH: transcript whose truth is not scorable on the domain (< 3 positions or constant truth): KEPT in N_domain; excluded from N_truth_scorable, from every performance statistic and from every paired set; never counted as a model failure
status_codes.NO_PAIRED_SUPPORT: dataset x method pair: empty paired set -> NA, no number, no rank
status_codes.transcript_unscorable_for_method: removes the transcript from that method's set only; not MODEL_FAILED

aggregation.cell: M(d,m,s,f;T) = median over transcripts in T of per-transcript Pearson
aggregation.method_score: S(d,m;T) = mean over pre-registered seeds of [ mean over 5 folds (equal weight) of M ]; single-model expected performance, NOT an ensemble of seed predictions

sets.absolute: T_A,f = {t in test fold f : truth-scorable on the domain AND A scorable on the domain in EVERY pre-registered seed}
sets.paired: T_AB,f = per fold f, per method pair (A,B): truth-scorable AND A scorable in every pre-registered seed AND B scorable in every pre-registered seed (one common set for all seeds of both methods; never a per-seed set)
sets.fig_A_forest: each cell uses its own T_AB,f; the cell is annotated with N_paired = sum over folds of the size of T_AB,f and N_paired/N_truth_scorable
sets.fig_B_interior_vs_full: one common population per (dataset, method): transcripts truth-scorable on BOTH domains and scorable by the method on BOTH domains (interior: model positions only; full: deployed policy) in every seed; both bars computed on that same population
sets.mfe_interaction: common set of the four arms (RiboPipe H128 +/-MFE, RiboMIMO-adapt +/-MFE): truth-scorable AND all four arms scorable in every seed
sets.deterministic_methods: seed set = {det}; 'every seed' means that single run

report_format.score: S mean [min, max] over the pre-registered seeds (deterministic: single value)
report_format.coverage: N_domain = universe transcripts whose domain is non-empty (interior: L > 40 codons); N_truth_scorable <= N_domain; N_scored = sum over folds of the size of T_A,f (truth-scorable AND scorable by the method in every seed). Report N_scored/N_domain (overall scorable fraction) AND N_scored/N_truth_scorable (what the method itself loses)
report_format.units: per dataset: universe size, N_domain, N_truth_scorable from report/ledgers/data_eligibility_ledger.json (pre-run); N_scored, failures, N_paired from the run/scoring ledger (post-T1)

aggregation.denominator_regression: PRJNA_iPS interior: N_domain 751 -> N_truth_scorable 750 -> N_scored (per method); asserted by paper_eval/build_eligibility_ledger.py
aggregation.empty_fold: if a fold's set is empty (absolute: T_A,f; paired: T_AB,f) while the models trained successfully, the five-fold quantity is 'NA: empty paired fold' (listing the fold); never re-averaged over the remaining folds and never MODEL_FAILED

secondary: peak recall: true peaks = top 5% of truth in domain (fixed); predicted top-k with expected-hit tie handling at the cutoff
supplementary: amplitude recovery (no test-truth optimal rescaling for deployable claims)
metrics.peak_recall_rule: true peaks = domain positions with y >= numpy.quantile(y_domain, 0.95, linear); all truth ties at that value are included; k = number of true peaks; k = 0 or k = domain length -> unscorable for this metric; predicted top-k: positions strictly above the k-th largest prediction are taken, ties at the k-th value contribute expected hits = (k - n_strictly_above) * (true peaks among the tied) / (number tied); recall = expected hits / k

uncertainty.interval: cluster bootstrap within fold over frozen similarity units; one draw applies to both methods and all seeds; recompute full Delta; B=2000; 95% percentile (descriptive)

superiority.cells: interior per-transcript Pearson x 3 core comparators x 8 datasets

families.failed_or_NA_cells: stay in the family with p = 1 (never rejected); family size m stays 24; no re-run to fill a failed cell
families.independence: two families controlled separately; no claim is made across families
families.figure_vs_test: figure classes come from the 95% bootstrap CI (descriptive); a 'formal' marker is added only for Holm-rejected cells

decision.p_values: boundary-shifted Wald with cluster-bootstrap SE (B=2000, unit resampling within fold, same draw for both methods and all seeds): p_sup = 1 - Phi((D - delta)/SE); TOST p_lo = 1 - Phi((D + delta)/SE), p_hi = Phi((D - delta)/SE), p_eq = max(p_lo, p_hi); SE = 0 -> p by sign of the boundary comparison

statistical_claims.better_than_zero: NOT pre-registered and NOT tested; the manuscript must not state 'significantly better than zero'
statistical_claims.figure_classes: descriptive only: colour from the 95% cluster-bootstrap CI vs +/-0.01 (superior / inferior / equivalent / undetermined); 'formal' marker only for Holm-rejected cells
statistical_claims.undetermined: means the CI touches or crosses a bound; it is NOT evidence of no difference
statistical_claims.failed_or_NA: p = 1 inside its family (m stays 24); effect size reported as NA, never imputed
statistical_claims.seed_range: [min, max] over the three seeds is a retraining range, NOT a confidence interval

seeds.machine_interruption: resume with original config and seed; logged

retry_stabilized_ixnos_mfe.attempt_seeds: s, s+1000, s+2000 per original seed x fold
retry_stabilized_ixnos_mfe.trigger: training output all zero OR validation loss non-finite

Paper_RiboPipe_MFE_H128.config: MB1v2NoC2MFE H128 (228,321 params); gamma=0.5 weighted log-MSE; Adam 1e-3 wd 1e-6 StepLR(5,0.95); window 64 / stride 16; <=99 epochs; patience 5 on val median per-tx Pearson; no dropout; MFE standardized per fold on training valid windows (MFE_NORM_FOLDWISE.json), padding masked

Paper_RiboMIMO.label: official architecture, adapted training driver
Paper_RiboMIMO.config: official 97-dim input & network; training coverage filter mean(c>0.5)>0.6; Xavier; class thresholds computed before end trimming; 5/4 end handling; loss domain c>0.5; MSE + 3*CE; frozen val

Paper_iXnos_seq.config: codon[-5,+4] + nt[-15,+14]; 20/20 training trim; interior-mean target; MSE; official gene filters (min_cod_w_data=100; top-500 from current training fold only, all if <500, count logged); schedule human 70/32, yeast 60/16, E. coli 60/16 (pre-registered cross-species adaptation); log windows and optimizer steps

Paper_iXnos_MFE.config: as iXnos_seq + 3 raw MFE windows (footprint windows); fixed-seed original recipe (core comparator)

Paper_iXnos_MFE_stabilized.config: as iXnos_MFE + retry rule (seeds.retry_stabilized_ixnos_mfe); separately named

Paper_RiboExp.config: official default WITH structure features, official training filters, effective windows, selector; native validation frequency / rationale-length condition restored or explicitly labelled; params counted on full predictive path; if numeric check vs official fails -> report 'faithful reproduction not achieved' (no substitution)

Paper_RiboGL_heldout.config: official code; native TRAINING gene filter restored (coverage>30%, NaN<=5%, max zero-run<=20) for training only; checkpoint on frozen val; inference on all eligible test transcripts; blind-inference test required; output softmax scored as-is against linear truth (Pearson, Spearman) + native-scale correlation reported

Paper_RUST.config: enrichment re-implementation, no 1000 cap, trained once

Paper_Ridge.config: one-hot +/-5 codons, alpha=10, fit on training fold only, trained once

T3.Paper_RiboPipe_noMFE_H128: identical to Paper_RiboPipe_MFE_H128 except the 3 MFE inputs and the parameters they require
T3.Paper_RiboPipe_MFE_H110: width check: as MFE_H128 with hidden 110
T3.Paper_RiboPipe_noMFE_H110: width check: as noMFE_H128 with hidden 110
T3.Paper_RiboMIMO_adapt_MFE: task-adapted RiboMIMO backbone + the same 3 valid MFE inputs (fold-wise standardised, padding masked)
T3.Paper_RiboMIMO_adapt_noMFE: identical to Paper_RiboMIMO_adapt_MFE except the MFE inputs and the parameters they require
T3.loss_target_3_arm3: linear y + plain SE = the SAME config as T2 Paper_RiboPipe_MFE_linear (no separate config_id)

T2.Paper_RiboPipe_MFE_linear: RiboPipe-MFE H128 trained on linear y = c/mean(c), plain SE
T2.Paper_RiboMIMO_L2: RiboMIMO with y = c/mean(c), padding-only mask, no end trim
T2.Paper_iXnos_nocut: iXnos with y = c/mean(c), no 20/20 trim
T2.Paper_RiboGL_L2_heldout: prediction = L_eff * softmax(z) vs y, padding excluded; loss coefficients and reduction registered

partII_crossover.y: median model corr - median sparse-reads corr on the same transcripts per depth bin
partII_crossover.roles: compute per role, equal-weight average per bin
partII_crossover.interp: log depth, linear between adjacent valid bins (N_scored>=30)
partII_crossover.crossing: unique positive->negative zero crossing within observed range; no gap crossing, no extrapolation
partII_crossover.report: D*, 95% CI, localization success rate. When D* is not reported, use exactly one of: 'the paired difference did not change sign within [lo, hi] reads/codon' or 'no crossover could be located under the pre-registered rule' (multiple candidates, gap, or bootstrap localization failure > 10%). Never 'no crossover exists'
partII_crossover.machine_readable: protocol/PARTII_CROSSOVER_v1.json md5 97bb105830d658f375da6712f87ad425 (candidate; reference implementation paper_eval/partII_crossover.py with numerical example)

pilots.acceptance_uses: training/validation side and engineering checks only
release_criteria: test counts invisible to inference (blind test with cache rebuild)
fold / similarity unit / position keys consistent
same predictions rebuild main table and forest plot (synthetic file + independent scorer)
pilots.scope: each pilot = one real fold: verifies real inputs, blind inference, logs, bitwise outputs and SINGLE-FOLD rebuild of main-table and forest-plot quantities; five-fold behaviours (equal-weight fold mean, empty single fold) are verified on the five-fold synthetic file

governed_by_this_protocol: Part II training of predictors (same frozen folds; Part II scoring rules in GUARDRAILS_PartII_III)
NOT_governed (separately labelled, own d: T0 reproduction under each method's original protocol

register_and_admission.register: all human model inputs/outputs and truths are A-site (v3 npz already A-site; no extra offset may be applied)
register_and_admission.human_partI_admission: cov = sum(c)/(3L) > 0.5 reads/nt (= 1.5 reads/codon), replicate mean; this threshold is ONLY the human Part I high-coverage admission rule
register_and_admission.nonhuman_admission: RiboMIMO Supplementary Table S1 official transcript lists (no length cap); the 0.5 reads/nt rule is NOT applied
register_and_admission.partII_T_low: all expressed (sum c > 0) non-high human transcripts; the 0.5 reads/nt rule defines only its complement
register_and_admission.scope_of_threshold: >0.5 reads/nt (>1.5 reads/codon) is the human Part I ADMISSION rule only; it is not a cross-species threshold and does not define Part II scorability

T1_fig_A.question: relative to each core comparator, how large is the paired difference on each dataset, and is it outside / inside / across the +/-0.01 band
T1_fig_A.allowed: superior / inferior / equivalent / undetermined per CI; 'formal' only if Holm-rejected

T1_fig_B.question: does the class of each pre-registered pair change between interior and full-length scoring (same transcripts)
T1_fig_B.allowed: both Deltas with CIs on one ID set; 'class changed / unchanged'
T1_fig_B.forbidden: attributing a full_deployed drop to the model (only full_native can)

T3_width.question: how much does performance differ within the tested width range
T3_width.allowed: differences within the tested range (e.g. H64-H128), with interval
T3_width.forbidden: capacity is not limiting; architecture-level statements beyond the tested range

T2.question: does the ranking change when training targets are matched
T2.allowed: rank/Delta under matched targets vs native
T2.forbidden: the gap is independent of target

T1_main_table.question: absolute performance of each method on its own scorable set, with coverage
T1_main_table.allowed: values with seed range and coverage; formal claims ONLY for the three pre-registered pairs of Fig A
T1_main_table.forbidden: a full ranking of all methods; differences of two main-table numbers as comparisons

ledgers.data_eligibility: report/ledgers/data_eligibility_ledger.json (built now from frozen data; script paper_eval/build_eligibility_ledger.py)
ledgers.run_scoring: built only after T1 by score_partI.py: per method x dataset x seed x fold status, N_scored, failures, N_paired; never pre-filled
